title: 2022 CODATA: molar volume of ideal gas (273.15 K, 100 kPa) is 22.710 954 64... × 10^−3
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks molar volume of ideal gas (273.15 K, 100 kPa) as exact: 22.710 954 64...
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks molar volume of ideal gas (273.15 K, 100 kPa) as exact: 22.710 954 64... × 10^−3 m^3 mol^-1. The ellipsis is in the file. No further digits are added here. This is the ideal-gas molar volume at 273.15 K and the standard-state pressure of 100 kPa, marked exact in the 2022 listing. It is not the older 22.4 litre figure.
